statistical_framework.independent_cluster_unit: HDFS Block ID (session-level cluster) / BGL Temporal Node Cluster

experiment_families.research_question: Does joint multi-view alignment (Sequence + Temporal Graph with VICReg) outperform single-view baselines (Sequence-only, Graph-only) and unaligned fusion without representation collapse and without negative transfer?
experiment_families.hypothesis: Aligned multi-view representation z_mv achieves higher Average Precision (AP) on downstream detection than Sequence-only and Graph-only baselines by at least margin epsilon (-0.02), significantly beats unaligned fusion (delta > 0, p < 0.05 Bonferroni-corrected), and maintains latent variance Var(z) >= 0.01.
experiment_families.independent_variable: Representation View Modality (sequence_only, graph_only, unaligned_fusion, aligned_vicreg_fusion)
experiment_families.dependent_metric: Average Precision (AP) Difference over Clusters, Latent Variance, Representation Collapse Flag
experiment_families.baseline: Sequence-only (Stage A1 Transformer) and Graph-only (Stage A2 TGNN), Unaligned Concatenation
experiment_families.treatment: MultiViewRepresentationModel (mode='aligned', VICReg sim/var/cov loss, Gated Dynamic Fusion)
experiment_families.split: SPL-HDFS-001 Strict Causal Temporal Split (Train: 35,000 sessions / 586,577 events; Val: 7,500 sessions / 119,531 events)
experiment_families.checkpoint_policy: Checkpoint on global validation loss minimum; last checkpoint preserved; operational stream cursor serialized

frozen_trainable_parameters.pretraining: Backbone extractors, projection heads, fusion gates all trainable
frozen_trainable_parameters.downstream_probing: Backbone strictly FROZEN (grad == 0); capacity-controlled linear probe (dim=128 to 2) trained on Train, evaluated on Val

experiment_families.stopping_rule: Early stopping with patience=3 completed epochs on global validation loss or ceiling of 12 completed epochs
experiment_families.primary_metric: Average Precision (AP) Difference over Clusters with Paired Cluster Bootstrap (B=2000, seed=10007, alpha=0.05)
experiment_families.decision_rule: SUPPORTED if boot_vs_seq['observed_delta'] >= -0.02 and boot_vs_graph['observed_delta'] >= -0.02 and boot_vs_unaligned['verdict'] == 'SUPPORTED' and not variance_collapsed. FALSIFIED if boot_vs_seq or boot_vs_graph is FALSIFIED (significantly worse) or variance_collapsed. INCONCLUSIVE otherwise.
experiment_families.allowed_inference: Multi-view representation successfully fuses sequential and relational structural telemetry without catastrophic interference on the evaluated temporal distribution.
experiment_families.forbidden_inference: Does NOT prove negative-transfer prevention on out-of-distribution log formats or unmodeled zero-day event classes.

experiment_families.research_question: Does security-aware dynamic parameter representation preserve dynamic security-relevant semantics compared to template-only abstraction under identical architecture, split, and probe capacity?
experiment_families.hypothesis: Parameter-aware representation z_param achieves statistically superior downstream Average Precision (AP) and parameter category recovery over template-only representation z_template under identical frozen backbone capacity.
experiment_families.independent_variable: Dynamic Parameter Representation (Parameter-Aware with typed slots vs Template-Only with param_slots=None)
experiment_families.dependent_metric: Downstream Average Precision (AP) on Anomaly Target, Parameter Category Probe Recovery AP
experiment_families.treatment: Parameter-aware representation z_param (bounded multi-slot typed parameters K=4)
experiment_families.split: Strict Causal Temporal Split (Train fit, Val evaluate)
experiment_families.checkpoint_policy: Frozen pre-existing Stage A1 & Stage A2 & Multi-View checkpoints

frozen_trainable_parameters.probe: Linear / Logistic Probe W in R^{128 x C} trained on Train split

experiment_families.primary_metric: Average Precision (AP) Difference over Clusters with Paired Cluster Bootstrap (B=2000, seed=10007, alpha=0.05, Bonferroni)
experiment_families.decision_rule: SUPPORTED if boot['verdict'] == 'SUPPORTED' (delta > 0, CI_lower > 0). FALSIFIED if boot['verdict'] == 'FALSIFIED' (delta <= 0). INCONCLUSIVE otherwise.
experiment_families.allowed_inference: Security-aware parameter representation linearly preserves security-relevant parameter dynamics that template-only abstraction discards.
experiment_families.forbidden_inference: Does NOT imply exact reconstruction of arbitrary unmapped string payloads or natural language text.

experiment_families.research_question: Are learned representations robust against semantic-preserving perturbations and shortcut shifts (P01..P12) without requiring backbone retraining?
experiment_families.hypothesis: Representation quality degradation under 12 semantic-preserving perturbation operators (P01..P12) on the Validation split is strictly bounded (AP retention >= 80%), controlling False Discovery Rate at q < 0.05 via Benjamini-Hochberg.
experiment_families.independent_variable: Validation Perturbation Operator (P01 Token Deletion, P02 Token Insertion Noise, P03 Parameter Obfuscation, P04 Event Order Jitter, P05 IP Translation, P06 Path Aliasing, P07 Burst Interleaving, P08 Unseen Template Shift, P09 Host Reassignment, P10 Pseudonym Rotation, P11 Timestamp Skew, P12 Composite)
experiment_families.dependent_metric: Relative AP Retention Ratio AP(z') / AP(z), Delta AP, BH-FDR Adjusted q-values
experiment_families.treatment: Perturbed Validation Representation z' passed through frozen probe
experiment_families.checkpoint_policy: Frozen checkpoints from Stage A1, Stage A2, and Multi-View
experiment_families.primary_metric: Mean Relative AP Retention across P01..P12 under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (q < 0.05)
experiment_families.decision_rule: SUPPORTED if mean AP retention >= 0.80 and no individual operator causes collapse to chance prevalence pi. FALSIFIED if mean retention < 0.50 or any operator drops AP below chance prevalence. INCONCLUSIVE otherwise.
experiment_families.allowed_inference: Model representations resist superficial token deletions, formatting obfuscations, and timestamp concurrency jitter without collapsing.
experiment_families.forbidden_inference: Does NOT imply robustness against semantic evasion attacks that fundamentally alter the causal execution graph.

experiment_families.research_question: Does the end-to-end multi-view extraction and fusion inference pipeline satisfy the operational Service Level Objective (SLO) on edge hardware?
experiment_families.hypothesis: The inference pipeline conjunctively satisfies all three SLO thresholds: p95 latency <= 10.0 ms/sequence, peak host RAM <= 500.0 MB, processing throughput >= 10,000 telemetry events/sec.
experiment_families.construct: Operational Feasibility on Edge Telemetry Hardware
experiment_families.independent_variable: Pipeline Execution Mode (End-to-End vs Incremental Fusion)
experiment_families.dependent_metric: p95 Latency (ms), Peak RAM (MB), Peak VRAM (MB), Event Throughput (events/s)
experiment_families.baseline: Static Pre-Registered SLO Thresholds (10 ms, 500 MB, 10,000 events/s)
experiment_families.primary_metric: Conjunctive Binary SLO Satisfaction (All 3 conditions == True)
experiment_families.decision_rule: SUPPORTED if (p95 <= 10.0) and (peak_ram <= 500.0) and (throughput >= 10000.0). FALSIFIED if any of the three criteria fail. INCONCLUSIVE if system interrupt occurs.
experiment_families.allowed_inference: The deployed inference pipeline meets operational constraints for real-time telemetry streaming on host systems.
experiment_families.forbidden_inference: Does NOT measure cluster-wide distributed coordination or network ingestion bottlenecks.

experiment_families.research_question: How does controlled linkability compare against raw identifiers and extreme anonymization across four distinct adversarial attacks?
experiment_families.hypothesis: Controlled linkability maintains downstream utility while reducing multi-adversary advantage (2 * |AUC - 0.5|) compared to raw identifiers.
experiment_families.status_notes: Code surveyed; deferred to post-H2/H1/H3 phase to preserve compute budget for highest priority confirmatory ablations.
